items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: Yes, this was when she split up with him.

ctx.x: Was this when she split up with Red Norvo?

Yes, this was when she split up with him. She was with him when I first met her and they had had a dispute or something. It happened one morning when I went to see her. But we'd go all up in Harlem and everything. Andy Kirk had a barbecue place and she ordered barbecued chili and so many different things and got sick that night and said the food was no good. The next time she went up there Andy said to her, 'Well, if you eat as much as you eat, you will get sick.'
She had to do something to keep her figure.

items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: she loved Mary Lou -- she dearly loved Mary Lou.

ctx.x: I know you knew her, you knew that she wasn't envious -
I did. I know. I mean Mildred -- I mean the people that Mildred loved, the gals that Mildred loved, she loved Mary Lou -- she dearly loved Mary Lou.
